answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities unprofitable by charging a sunk cost per identity. Each agent pays a fee equal to 10 days of earnings, burned on entry, and gets a jade seal checked at the harbor gate. A garden plot is checked against that receipt, so one payment cannot open many plots. Making 100 fakes costs 100 fees, or 1,000 days of earnings, with nothing back. An honest agent pays once, recovers it in 10 days, and earns undiluted rewards.
